notes: kb/Work PB334, LANDED (this record added by landing train 13, whose implementer worktree predated the row's re-attribution from PB335). RULE: 'An implicit or explicit NEXT phrase or a PREVIOUS phrase results in a sequential read: otherwise, the read is a random read and the rules for format 2 apply.' (cite.py --check 14.9.30.4 -> OK 19).) The row recorded TWO INDEPENDENT DIVERGENCES and both are now closed. (1) SR9's TRIGGER SET WAS INCOMPLETE. SR9 -- 'the NEXT phrase is implied if any of the following phrases is specified: ADVANCING, AT END, or NOT AT END' (cite.py --check 14.9.30.3 -> OK 9.) -- was tested on two of its three members, so under ACCESS DYNAMIC a bare `READ f ADVANCING ON LOCK` bound as the Format-2 random read and GR19 applied the WRONG format's rules. Closed by kb/Work PB340 on landing train 12; on this tree KeyedIoBinder.BindRead's dynamic arm reads `next || contention?.readAdvancingOnLock() is not null || ConditionalPhrases.HasFamily(r.conditionalPhrases(), ConditionalPhraseFamily.AtEnd)`, and conformance:cases/14.9.30-READ/pb340_advancing_on_lock_relative and conformance:cases/14.9.30-READ/pb340_advancing_on_lock_indexed are its witnesses -- each carries a plain READ NEXT '51' control proving the locks were really in the way. (2) THE SEQUENTIAL ORGANIZATION HAD NO DIRECTION AT ALL. SequentialIoBinder.BindRead never called r.readDirection() and BoundRead carried no direction member, so PREVIOUS was dropped for RECORD and LINE SEQUENTIAL files and GR19 routed a backward read as a forward one. Closed here: KeyedReadKind became ReadKind { Next, Previous, Random } on BOTH bound READ nodes through the new IBoundRead, the sequential arm reads its direction phrase, and SequentialConnector.Read(previous, ...) implements GR21's sequential block. conformance:{2002,2014,2023}/pb334_read_previous_sequential is the witness at all three editions the phrase exists in, and conformance:cases/14.9.30-READ/pb334-read-previous-line-sequential pins SR7's refusal. GR19's routing is only as right as SR8/SR9 are, and BOTH now hold: SR8 is unconditional on the sequential ORGANIZATION arm because 12.4.5.5.2 SR2 -- 'The DYNAMIC and RANDOM phrases shall not be specified for a sequential file' (cite.py --check 12.4.5.5.2 -> OK 2).) -- bars the other access modes there. EDITIONS: unchanged 85,2002,2014,2023 -- both defects were in the binder and therefore edition-invariant; the PREVIOUS phrase itself is gated separately at 85 by COBOL0900.
